		<!-- 2026.2.708.462 --><div id="winManager_alerttemplate" style="display:none;">
        <div class="rwDialog rwAlertDialog">
            <div class="rwDialogContent">
                <div class="rwDialogMessage" role="alert">{1}</div>
            </div>
            <div class="rwDialogButtons">
                <button type="button" class="rwOkBtn" onclick="$find('{0}').close(true); return false;">##LOC[OK]##</button>
            </div>
        </div>
        </div><div id="winManager_prompttemplate" style="display:none;">
        <div class="rwDialog rwPromptDialog">
            <div class="rwDialogContent">
                <div class="rwDialogMessage">{1}</div>
                <div class="rwPromptInputContainer">
                    <script type="text/javascript">
                        function RadWindowprompt_detectenter(id, ev, input) {
                            if (!ev) ev = window.event;
                            if (ev.keyCode == 13) {
                                var but = input.parentNode.parentNode.parentNode.getElementsByTagName("button")[0];
                                if (but) {
                                    if (but.click) {
                                        but.click();
                                    }
                                    else if (but.onclick) {
                                        but.focus();
                                        var click = but.onclick;
                                        but.onclick = null;
                                        if (click) click.call(but);
                                    }
                                }
                                return false;
                            }
                            else return true;
                        }
                    </script>
                    <input title="Enter Value" aria-label="Enter Value" onkeydown="return RadWindowprompt_detectenter('{0}', event, this);" type="text" class="rwPromptInput radPreventDecorate" value="{2}">
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="rwDialogButtons">
                <button type="button" class="rwOkBtn" onclick="$find('{0}').close(this.parentNode.parentNode.getElementsByTagName('input')[0].value); return false;">##LOC[OK]##</button>
                <button type="button" class="rwCancelBtn" onclick="$find('{0}').close(null); return false;">##LOC[Cancel]##</button>
            </div>
        </div>
        </div><div id="winManager_confirmtemplate" style="display:none;">
        <div class="rwDialog rwConfirmDialog">
            <div class="rwDialogContent">
                <div class="rwDialogMessage">{1}</div>
            </div>
            <div class="rwDialogButtons">
                <button type="button" class="rwOkBtn" onclick="$find('{0}').close(true); return false;">##LOC[OK]##</button>
                <button type="button" class="rwCancelBtn" onclick="$find('{0}').close(false); return false;">##LOC[Cancel]##</button>
            </div>
        </div>
        </div><input id="winManager_ClientState" name="winManager_ClientState" type="hidden">
	</div>
</div>

<style>
    /* ================= SUCCESS ================= */

    .RadNotification_Bootstrap .rnContentWrapper .rnIconWarning:before {
        color: #22c55e !important;
    }

    .RadNotification_Bootstrap {
        border-color: #22c55e !important;
        color: #1f2937 !important;
        background: rgba(240,253,244,0.9) !important;
        font: 1.2em "Inter","Segoe UI",Verdana !important;
        font-weight: 400 !important;
        backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    }

        .RadNotification_Bootstrap .rnContentWrapper .rnIcon:before {
            font-size: 26px !important;
            color: #22c55e !important;
        }

        .RadNotification_Bootstrap .rnTitleBar {
            background: transparent !important;
            font: 1.3em "Inter","Segoe UI",Verdana !important;
            color: #166534 !important;
            border-bottom-width: 0px !important;
            font-weight: 600 !important;
        }

        .RadNotification_Bootstrap .rnContent {
            padding: .6em .5em 0 2.8em !important;
            font-size: 14px !important;
            color: #374151 !important;
        }

        .RadNotification_Bootstrap .rnCommands a:hover {
            border-color: transparent !important;
            background-color: transparent !important;
        }

    /* KUTU */
    .RadNotification_Bootstrap {
        margin: 0 !important;
        padding: 0 !important;
        border-width: 0px 0px 0px 6px !important;
        border-style: solid !important;
        word-wrap: break-word !important;
        z-index: 9001 !important;
        overflow: hidden !important;
        line-height: 1.5 !important;
        border-radius: 12px !important;
        transition: all .25s ease;
    }

        /* HOVER */
        .RadNotification_Bootstrap:hover {
            transform: translate3d(0, -2px, 0);
            box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(34,197,94,0.25) !important;
        }

    .RadNotification_Default:hover {
        transform: translate3d(0, -2px, 0);
        box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(239,68,68,0.25) !important;
    }

    .RadNotification_Bootstrap.rnShadows {
        box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(34,197,94,0.15) !important;
    }

    .RadNotification_Bootstrap.rnRoundedCorners {
        border-radius: 12px !important;
    }

    .RadNotification_Bootstrap .rnCommands a {
        font-weight: 700 !important;
        opacity: .6;
        transition: .2s;
    }

        .RadNotification_Bootstrap .rnCommands a:hover {
            opacity: 1;
        }

    .RadNotification_Bootstrap .rnContentWrapper .rnIcon {
        top: 10px !important;
        left: 10px !important;
    }


    /* ================= ERROR ================= */

    .RadNotification_Default .rnContentWrapper .rnIconWarning:before {
        color: #ef4444 !important;
    }

    .RadNotification_Default.rnShadows {
        box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(239,68,68,0.15) !important;
    }

    .RadNotification_Default {
        border-color: #ef4444 !important;
        color: #1f2937 !important;
        background: rgba(254,242,242,0.9) !important;
        font: 1.2em "Inter","Segoe UI",Verdana !important;
        font-weight: 400 !important;
        backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    }

        .RadNotification_Default .rnContentWrapper .rnIcon:before {
            font-size: 26px !important;
            color: #ef4444 !important;
        }

        .RadNotification_Default .rnTitleBar {
            background: transparent !important;
            font: 1.3em "Inter","Segoe UI",Verdana !important;
            color: #991b1b !important;
            border-bottom-width: 0px !important;
            font-weight: 600 !important;
            background-image: none !important;
        }

        .RadNotification_Default .rnContent {
            padding: .6em .5em 0 2.8em !important;
            font-size: 14px !important;
            color: #374151 !important;
        }

        .RadNotification_Default .rnCommands a:hover {
            border-color: transparent !important;
            background-color: transparent !important;
            background-image: none !important;
        }

    /* KUTU */
    .RadNotification_Default {
        margin: 0 !important;
        padding: 0 !important;
        border-width: 0px 0px 0px 6px !important;
        border-style: solid !important;
        word-wrap: break-word !important;
        z-index: 9001 !important;
        overflow: hidden !important;
        line-height: 1.5 !important;
        border-radius: 12px !important;
        transition: all .25s ease;
    }

        /* HOVER */
        .RadNotification_Default:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(239,68,68,0.25) !important;
        }

        .RadNotification_Default.rnRoundedCorners {
            border-radius: 12px !important;
        }

    @keyframes fadeSlide {

            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(10px);
        }

            transform: translateY(0);
        }
    }

    .RadNotification {
        animation: fadeSlide .25s ease-out;
        animation-fill-mode: both;
        will-change: transform, opacity;

    .RadNotification_Bootstrap,
    .RadNotification_Default {
        transform: translateZ(0);
        backface-visibility: hidden;

    .RadNotification .rnCommands a {

    /* ================= SUCCESS ================= */

    .RadNotification_Bootstrap .rnContentWrapper .rnIconWarning:before {
        color: #22c55e !important;
    }

    .RadNotification_Bootstrap {
        border-color: #22c55e !important;
        color: #1f2937 !important;
        background: rgba(240,253,244,0.9) !important;
        font: 1.2em "Inter","Segoe UI",Verdana !important;
        font-weight: 400 !important;
        backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    }

        .RadNotification_Bootstrap .rnContentWrapper .rnIcon:before {
            font-size: 26px !important;
            color: #22c55e !important;
        }

        .RadNotification_Bootstrap .rnTitleBar {
            background: transparent !important;
            font: 1.3em "Inter","Segoe UI",Verdana !important;
            color: #166534 !important;
            border-bottom-width: 0px !important;
            font-weight: 600 !important;
        }

        .RadNotification_Bootstrap .rnContent {
            padding: .6em .5em 0 2.8em !important;
            font-size: 14px !important;
            color: #374151 !important;
        }

        .RadNotification_Bootstrap .rnCommands a:hover {
            border-color: transparent !important;
            background-color: transparent !important;
        }

    /* KUTU */
    .RadNotification_Bootstrap {
        margin: 0 !important;
        padding: 0 !important;
        border-width: 0px 0px 0px 6px !important;
        border-style: solid !important;
        word-wrap: break-word !important;
        z-index: 9001 !important;
        overflow: hidden !important;
        line-height: 1.5 !important;
        border-radius: 12px !important;
        transition: all .25s ease;
    }

        /* HOVER */
        .RadNotification_Bootstrap:hover {
            transform: translate3d(0, -2px, 0);
            box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(34,197,94,0.25) !important;
        }

    .RadNotification_Default:hover {
        transform: translate3d(0, -2px, 0);
        box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(239,68,68,0.25) !important;
    }

    .RadNotification_Bootstrap.rnShadows {
        box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(34,197,94,0.15) !important;
    }

    .RadNotification_Bootstrap.rnRoundedCorners {
        border-radius: 12px !important;
    }

    .RadNotification_Bootstrap .rnCommands a {
        font-weight: 700 !important;
        opacity: .6;
        transition: .2s;
    }

        .RadNotification_Bootstrap .rnCommands a:hover {
            opacity: 1;
        }

    .RadNotification_Bootstrap .rnContentWrapper .rnIcon {
        top: 10px !important;
        left: 10px !important;
    }


    /* ================= ERROR ================= */

    .RadNotification_Default .rnContentWrapper .rnIconWarning:before {
        color: #ef4444 !important;
    }

    .RadNotification_Default.rnShadows {
        box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(239,68,68,0.15) !important;
    }

    .RadNotification_Default {
        border-color: #ef4444 !important;
        color: #1f2937 !important;
        background: rgba(254,242,242,0.9) !important;
        font: 1.2em "Inter","Segoe UI",Verdana !important;
        font-weight: 400 !important;
        backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    }

        .RadNotification_Default .rnContentWrapper .rnIcon:before {
            font-size: 26px !important;
            color: #ef4444 !important;
        }

        .RadNotification_Default .rnTitleBar {
            background: transparent !important;
            font: 1.3em "Inter","Segoe UI",Verdana !important;
            color: #991b1b !important;
            border-bottom-width: 0px !important;
            font-weight: 600 !important;
            background-image: none !important;
        }

        .RadNotification_Default .rnContent {
            padding: .6em .5em 0 2.8em !important;
            font-size: 14px !important;
            color: #374151 !important;
        }

        .RadNotification_Default .rnCommands a:hover {
            border-color: transparent !important;
            background-color: transparent !important;
            background-image: none !important;
        }

    /* KUTU */
    .RadNotification_Default {
        margin: 0 !important;
        padding: 0 !important;
        border-width: 0px 0px 0px 6px !important;
        border-style: solid !important;
        word-wrap: break-word !important;
        z-index: 9001 !important;
        overflow: hidden !important;
        line-height: 1.5 !important;
        border-radius: 12px !important;
        transition: all .25s ease;
    }

        /* HOVER */
        .RadNotification_Default:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(239,68,68,0.25) !important;
        }

        .RadNotification_Default.rnRoundedCorners {
            border-radius: 12px !important;
        }

        .RadNotification_Default .rnCommands a {
            font-weight: 700 !important;
            opacity: .6;
            transition: .2s;
        }

            .RadNotification_Default .rnCommands a:hover {
                opacity: 1;
            }

        .RadNotification_Default .rnContentWrapper .rnIcon {
            top: 10px !important;
            left: 10px !important;
        }


    /* ================= GLOBAL ================= */

    .RadNotification .rnCommands li a:before {
        font-size: 18px !important;
    }

    /* ANIMATION */
    @keyframes fadeSlide {
        from {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(10px);
        }

        to {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }
    }

    .RadNotification {
        animation: fadeSlide .25s ease-out;
        animation-fill-mode: both;
        will-change: transform, opacity;
    }

    .RadNotification_Bootstrap,
    .RadNotification_Default {
        transform: translateZ(0);
        backface-visibility: hidden;
    }

        .RadNotification_Bootstrap:hover {
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(34,197,94,0.2), 0 10px 30px rgba(34,197,94,0.25) !important;
            transform: none;
        }

    .RadNotification .rnCommands a {
        background: rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
    }

        .RadNotification .rnCommands a:hover {
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.08) !important;
        }
</style>

            border-bottom-width: 0px !important;
            font-weight: 600 !important;
        }

        .RadNotification_Bootstrap .rnContent {
            padding: .6em .5em 0 2.8em !important;
            font-size: 14px !important;
            color: #374151 !important;
        }

        .RadNotification_Bootstrap .rnCommands a:hover {
            border-color: transparent !important;
            background-color: transparent !important;
        }

    /* KUTU */
    .RadNotification_Bootstrap {
        margin: 0 !important;
        padding: 0 !important;
        border-width: 0px 0px 0px 6px !important;
        border-style: solid !important;
        word-wrap: break-word !important;
        z-index: 9001 !important;
        overflow: hidden !important;
        line-height: 1.5 !important;
        border-radius: 12px !important;
        transition: all .25s ease;
    }

        /* HOVER */
        .RadNotification_Bootstrap:hover {
            transform: translate3d(0, -2px, 0);
            box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(34,197,94,0.25) !important;
        }

    .RadNotification_Default:hover {
        transform: translate3d(0, -2px, 0);
        box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(239,68,68,0.25) !important;
    }

    .RadNotification_Bootstrap.rnShadows {
        box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(34,197,94,0.15) !important;
    }

    .RadNotification_Bootstrap.rnRoundedCorners {
        border-radius: 12px !important;
    }

    .RadNotification_Bootstrap .rnCommands a {
        font-weight: 700 !important;
        opacity: .6;
        transition: .2s;
    }

        .RadNotification_Bootstrap .rnCommands a:hover {
            opacity: 1;
        }

    .RadNotification_Bootstrap .rnContentWrapper .rnIcon {
        top: 10px !important;
        left: 10px !important;
    }


    /* ================= ERROR ================= */

    .RadNotification_Default .rnContentWrapper .rnIconWarning:before {
        color: #ef4444 !important;
    }

    .RadNotification_Default.rnShadows {
        box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(239,68,68,0.15) !important;
    }

    .RadNotification_Default {
        border-color: #ef4444 !important;
        color: #1f2937 !important;
        background: rgba(254,242,242,0.9) !important;
        font: 1.2em "Inter","Segoe UI",Verdana !important;
        font-weight: 400 !important;
        backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    }

        .RadNotification_Default .rnContentWrapper .rnIcon:before {
            font-size: 26px !important;
            color: #ef4444 !important;
        }

        .RadNotification_Default .rnTitleBar {
            background: transparent !important;
            font: 1.3em "Inter","Segoe UI",Verdana !important;
            color: #991b1b !important;
            border-bottom-width: 0px !important;
            font-weight: 600 !important;
            background-image: none !important;
        }

        .RadNotification_Default .rnContent {
            padding: .6em .5em 0 2.8em !important;
            font-size: 14px !important;
            color: #374151 !important;
        }

        .RadNotification_Default .rnCommands a:hover {
            border-color: transparent !important;
            background-color: transparent !important;
            background-image: none !important;
        }

    /* KUTU */
    .RadNotification_Default {
        margin: 0 !important;
        padding: 0 !important;
        border-width: 0px 0px 0px 6px !important;
        border-style: solid !important;
        word-wrap: break-word !important;
        z-index: 9001 !important;
        overflow: hidden !important;
        line-height: 1.5 !important;
        border-radius: 12px !important;
        transition: all .25s ease;
    }

        /* HOVER */
        .RadNotification_Default:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(239,68,68,0.25) !important;
        }

        .RadNotification_Default.rnRoundedCorners {
            border-radius: 12px !important;
        }

        .RadNotification_Default .rnCommands a {
            font-weight: 700 !important;
            opacity: .6;
            transition: .2s;
        }

            .RadNotification_Default .rnCommands a:hover {
                opacity: 1;
            }

        .RadNotification_Default .rnContentWrapper .rnIcon {
            top: 10px !important;
            left: 10px !important;
        }


    /* ================= GLOBAL ================= */

    .RadNotification .rnCommands li a:before {
        font-size: 18px !important;
    }

    /* ANIMATION */
    @keyframes fadeSlide {
        from {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(10px);
        }

        to {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }
    }

    .RadNotification {
        animation: fadeSlide .25s ease-out;
        animation-fill-mode: both;
        will-change: transform, opacity;
    }

    .RadNotification_Bootstrap,
    .RadNotification_Default {
        transform: translateZ(0);
        backface-visibility: hidden;
    }

        .RadNotification_Bootstrap:hover {
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(34,197,94,0.2), 0 10px 30px rgba(34,197,94,0.25) !important;
            transform: none;
        }

    .RadNotification .rnCommands a {
        background: rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
    }

        .RadNotification .rnCommands a:hover {
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.08) !important;
        }
</style>
